crossRefs.note: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
“Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

translations.web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
translations.bsb: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
translations.kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed
translations.asv: And they forgat his doings, And his wondrous works that he had showed them.
